title: Malicious code in @mr-supun-fernando/news-scrap (npm)
description: The npm package '@mr-supun-fernando/news-scrap' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise may allow an attacker to gain full control of the system, risking exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but removal alone may not eliminate all malicious components. Secrets and keys should be rotated from a different, trusted machine to prevent further damage.
